AS message FROM linked_card_tbl lc INNER JOIN card_tbl c ON lc.card_code = c.card_code WHERE lc.user_id = #{userId} AND lc.represent_yn = 'Y' AND lc.delete_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1

SELECT lc.card_code AS cardId, lc.user_id AS userId, c.card_num AS cardNum, c.expiry_date AS expiryDate, lc.represent_yn AS representYn FROM linked_card_tbl lc INNER JOIN card_tbl c ON lc.card_code = c.card_code WHERE lc.user_id = #{userId} AND lc.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY lc.card_code DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO linked_card_tbl ( user_id, card_code, card_company_code, represent_yn, delete_yn ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{cardCode}, COALESCE(#{cardCompanyCode}, 'KB'), #{representYn}, 'N' )

INSERT INTO user_agreements_tbl ( user_id, agreement_id, agreed_yn, agreed_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{agreementId}, #{agreedYn}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE agreed_yn = #{agreedYn}, agreed_at = NOW()
